1496-1981-5147.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
1496-1981-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing any other creature you control, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

240-1251-5470-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
240-1251-5470-8227.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Loot by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Loot ability, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

1409-2811-8160.description:
Activate Kwia by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Kwia enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability and Elas il-Kor trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Kwia.
Resolve the Elas il-Kor trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat.

2395-4508-5929-7863--165.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to draw a card.
"Pirate" chosen with Leyline of Transformation.
2395-4508-5929-7863--165.description:
Draw a card.
Human Torch triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcom triggers due to Leyline of Transformation, creating a Treasure token.
The Treasure enters the battlefield, triggering Quicksmith Genius, causing you to draw a card and discard a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-4908-5131-5315--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-4908-5131-5315--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Enthusiastic Mechanaut.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing the artifact, giving Ravenous Intruder +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

2073-2099-7876-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Consulate Dreadnought from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Consulate Dreadnought enters, Kolodin triggers, causing Consulate Dreadnought to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Consulate Dreadnought.
When Consulate Dreadnought dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

872-907-7857.description:
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Scaled Herbalist.
Repeat.

1742-2511-5003-7848.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four graveyards that each have seven or more cards in them.
1742-2511-5003-7848.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing The Master of Lake-town.
When The Master of Lake-town dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Master of Lake-town trigger, drawing a card for each graveyard that has seven or more cards in it.
Holding priority, activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Repeat step 4 three additional times.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return The Master of Lake-town from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.
1742-2511-5003-7848.notes: If your graveyard has six cards in it, you can count that as one of the graveyards with seven cards in it, as The Master of Lake-town will count as the seventh card.

64-1987-3110.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
64-1987-3110.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Warden of the Eye.
When Warden of the Eye enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
64-1987-3110.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

3227-3617-7631.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Scrivener
When the Scrivener token enters, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

206-1170-1328-2105.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant card exiled by Spellbinder's imprint ability that has legal targets, if needed.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Spellbinder attached to any creature except Combat Celebrant that does not have summoning sickness.
206-1170-1328-2105.description:
Declare Combat Celebrant and the creature with Spellbinder attached as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Spellbinder attached.
Spellbinder triggers, causing you to copy a card exiled with it, and cast the copy without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Resolve the spell cast in step 4.
Repeat each combat phase.

240-3480-5256-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat from step 2.

3767-3918-7013-7040.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that share a creature type.
3767-3918-7013-7040.description:
Activate Trazyn using White Lotus Tile's ability by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2173-2932-5220-6797.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2173-2932-5220-6797.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional nontoken creature with mana value 1 or less.
2173-2932-5220-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature with mana value 1 or less.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Bontu's Monument triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

339-677-1753-5256.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3787-3976-4406.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3787-3976-4406.description:
Cast Chance for Glory by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and to lose the game at the beginning of that turn's end step.
Activate Magar by paying {1}{B}{R}, noting Chance for Glory and putting it face down on the battlefield as a 3/3 creature.
Activate Magar by paying {1}{B}{R}, noting Time Stop and putting it face down on the battlefield as a 3/3 creature.
During your next turn, deal combat damage to an opponent using the face down creatures that have Chance for Glory and Time Stop noted. The creatures trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, casting a copy of Chance for Glory without paying its mana cost. Resolve the copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and to lose the game at the beginning of that turn's end step.
Resolve the second trigger, casting a copy of Time Stop without paying its mana cost. Resolve the copy, causing you to end the turn. This will prevent the Chance for Glory trigger from causing you to lose the game.
Repeat from step 3.

1661-1987-4423-5139.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Relic of Sauron by tapping them, adding {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Relic of Sauron.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

791-2290-6774.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
791-2290-6774.description:
Activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting two +1/+1 counters on Spike Feeder.
Activate Spike Feeder's second ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat.

2438-4871-6010--5.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the persist creature trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer ability, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure token enters the battlefield, Builder's Talent's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

141-4615.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
141-4615.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Quasiduplicate
141-4615.description:
Cast Quasiduplicate by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Quasiduplicate, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Quasiduplicate, creating a token copy of Naru Meha.
Put either Naru Meha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 3.

2608-4499-4747.notablePrerequisites: Alena does not have summoning sickness. You had a creature with power 3 or greater enter the battlefield this turn.
2608-4499-4747.description:
Activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Alena.
Repeat.

1799-2455-4659-5359.description:
Activate Reito Sentinel by paying {3}, putting Threefold Thunderhulk on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Threefold Thunderhulk into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Threefold Thunderhulk enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating three 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks three times by sacrificing Threefold Thunderhulk and two Gnomes, adding six {C}.
Repeat.

1201-1651-2557-3822.description:
Activate Witch's Oven by tapping it and sacrificing Feasting Troll King, creating four Food artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Foods, untapping Witch's Oven.
Activate Feasting Troll King by sacrificing three Foods, causing you to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1636-3685-4497-4814.notablePrerequisites:
Slobad does not have summoning sickness.
"Mirran" chosen with Mirrodin Besieged.
1636-3685-4497-4814.description:
Activate Slobad by tapping it and sacrificing Spine of Ish Sah, adding seven {R} that can only be spent to cast artifact spells or to activate abilities of artifacts.
Spine of Ish Sah leaves the battlefield, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Spine of Ish Sah by paying {7}.
Sai triggers, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
The Myr enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Spine of Ish Sah enters the battlefield, destroying target permanent.
Repeat.

2744-3490-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
2744-3490-4050.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on any creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
The Servo enters the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting a +1/+1 on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers for each +1/+1 counter placed this way.
Resolve all but one Animation Module trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the final Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

836-2781-3719.notablePrerequisites: You have chosen "war" using Archangel of Strife.
836-2781-3719.description:
Cast Ruthless Technomancer by paying {3}{B}.
Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, causing you to sacrifice Felidar Guardian and create four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing a Treasure token, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, blinking Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

91-1242-4050-5112.notablePrerequisites:
Cinderhaze Wretch and Endling each have a cage counter on them.
Phyrexian Altar on the battlefield or in exile with a cage counter on it.
91-1242-4050-5112.description:
Activate Mairsil using Endling's third ability by paying {B}, gaining Mairsil undying.
Activate Mairsil using Phyrexian Altar's ability by sacrificing Mairsil, adding {B}.
Mairsil's undying ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield.
Activate Mairsil using Cinderhaze Wretch's ability, putting -1/-1 on itself.
Repeat.
